movie.title: Hidden Face
movie.overview: Su-yeon, a cellist in an orchestra led by her fiancé and conductor Sung-jin, disappears one day, leaving behind only a video recording. Sung-jin is devasted over the loss of Su-yeon, but feels a strong attraction to Mi-ju, a cellist who fills in for his fiancée. Then one rainy night, Sung-jin and Mi-ju get swept away by their mutual desires for each other and commit an unforgivable act at Su-yeon's house.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a cellist suddenly disappears leaving only a video message behind, her grieving conductor fiancé forms a passionate connection with her replacement, unaware of the hidden secrets lurking within her house.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Devastated by the sudden disappearance of his cellist fiancée, Su-yeon, orchestra conductor Sung-jin struggles to pick up the pieces of his life. His grief takes a sudden turn when he meets Mi-ju, the talented cellist hired to replace Su-yeon in the orchestra. Driven by mutual desire, Sung-jin and Mi-ju begin a passionate affair, crossing moral boundaries inside Su-yeon's empty home. However, their illicit connection unfolds against a backdrop of sinister secrets and unrevealed truths surrounding Su-yeon's fate.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Sung-jin is a rising orchestra conductor whose life collapses when his fiancée and lead cellist, Su-yeon, abruptly vanishes without a trace. The only clue left behind is a cryptic video recording from Su-yeon, leaving Sung-jin consumed by heartbreak and confusion. In an effort to keep the orchestra moving forward, a new cellist named Mi-ju is brought in to fill Su-yeon's vacant chair. As Sung-jin works closely with Mi-ju, an undeniable tension and attraction quickly build between the two. Grief and loneliness push Sung-jin toward Mi-ju, who finds herself equally captivated by the magnetic conductor. Their growing passion culminates on a rainy night when they give in to their mutual desires at Su-yeon’s residence. Unbeknownst to them, their secret affair takes place inside a house shrouded in mysterious circumstances regarding Su-yeon's sudden departure. As psychological boundaries blur, the truth behind Su-yeon's disappearance begins to unravel, transforming their desire into a dangerous web of deception. Ultimately, the consequences of their unforgivable betrayal force each character to face the reality of what truly happened behind closed doors.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Hidden Face is a tense psychological thriller that explores the dark intersections of grief, passion, and betrayal. Following the abrupt disappearance of cellist Su-yeon, her fiancé—an orchestra conductor named Sung-jin—is left searching for answers after receiving only a mysterious video message. As Sung-jin tries to maintain control of his personal and professional life, he crosses paths with Mi-ju, the replacement cellist taking Su-yeon's spot in the ensemble. What begins as a shared professional connection quickly turns into a intense romantic attraction, drawing both individuals into an unforgivable relationship inside Su-yeon's home. Beneath the surface of their illicit romance lies a suspenseful mystery that gradually exposes deep-seated secrets and tests the limits of trust.
